title: Xanthe and the Promise
author: Felix Iversen
blurb: Casper Okafor, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
